title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Job Title: Accounts Assistant

Location: Wolverhampton

Salary: £26,500 - £27,000

Top of the range will be offered to a candidate with at least 1 year of experience in Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable.

Join a growing law firm with locations in Wolverhampton and Birmingham as an Accounts Assistant. This role is ideal for someone with experience in accounts who can support with billing, reconciliations, payments, and general finance administration. This is a fantastic opportunity to become a key player in the day-to-day operations of the finance function in a supportive and professional environment. This position is particularly suitable for someone early in their career, as the company is eager to support their development and offers the opportunity to learn from experienced finance professionals

Responsibilities Will Include:
- Managing client and office account transactions.
- Processing payments, receipts and bank reconciliations.
- Supporting fee earners with billing and financial queries.
- Raising invoices and allocating incoming payments.
- Assisting with Legal Aid billing and general finance administration.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring compliance with company procedures.
- Undertake any other general ad-hoc duties as required

Ideally, You Will:
- Have a minimum of 1 year's experience within an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role.
- Be confident with bank reconciliations, payments, and invoice processing.
- Have strong communication skills and be comfortable building relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.
- Have strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- Be able to manage multiple priorities and work effectively as part of a team.

Benefits:
- Join a growing and supportive law firm with a friendly team environment.
- Gain exposure to a varied finance role with opportunities to develop your skills.
- Play an important role within the business and contribute to its continued success.
- Benefit from a stable, long-term opportunity where your contribution will be genuinely valued and they will support your career progression!

What Now?

To apply for this Accounts Assistant position, please submit your CV and cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are interested in this role. Interviews are being scheduled immediately, so don't hesitate to apply!

title: Finance/Admin Assistant
description:
Purpose and Scope of the Role

Job purpose:

To support the Finance Team in all aspects of the finance function and be responsible for the financial administration of the team's daily activities, while also supporting the wider organisation with general administrative duties.

The postholder will maintain accurate financial and administrative records and assist with the preparation of financial reports and month-end processes as required by the Senior Financial Controller. They will provide efficient support across a range of finance and administrative functions, ensuring that tasks are completed accurately and in a timely manner.

The successful candidate must be able to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, work collaboratively as part of a team, and use their own initiative when working independently. The role requires excellent organisational skills, a high level of accuracy and strong attention to detail.

Finance Responsibilities

The post holder will have at least 2 years' in-depth Admin & Book-keeping experience which includes:

Supporting the Financial Controller and Finance Officer with finance related projects.

Book keeping, including bank reconciliations, sales and purchase ledger maintenance.

Assisting the Junior Finance Manager to record and monitor and track income and expenditure and maintaining balanced and highly accurate records using QuickBooks.

Regular use of Excel to assist with maintaining and updating financial and admin documents.

Regular use of Word to send communication out to stakeholders

Maintaining petty cash for the petty cash. accounts for Volunteers' expenses and general petty cash accounts for all sites.

Meter readings collation and submissions for the utilities for all the RMC sites.

Ordering equipment and stationery using the correct process and negotiating with suppliers as well as matching invoices to delivery notes.

Monthly supplier statement reconciliations as well as liaising with suppliers to deal with any discrepancies.

Analyse staff expenses in line with the organisation's policy.

Assist in the weekly payment runs to suppliers through faster payment matching, batching, coding, and posting supplier invoices

Supporting the Senior Financial Controller and Junior Finance Manager with month-end reporting.

Filling and scanning documents

Project Administrative Support

Providing administrative support for project work across the organisation, working with colleagues in different departments to support the delivery of projects and agreed activities.

Maintaining project-related records, documents, trackers and spreadsheets, ensuring that information is accurate, up to date and easily accessible.

Supporting colleagues with the preparation and collation of project information, reports, presentations and other relevant documentation.

Assisting with monitoring project actions and deadlines, following up with relevant colleagues where required and providing updates to project leads.

Coordinating administrative arrangements for project meetings, events and activities, including room bookings, communications and distribution of relevant documents.

Liaising with internal departments to support the smooth administration and delivery of project activities.

Assisting with the collection, collation and organisation of project data and information to support monitoring, reporting and evaluation.

Providing general administrative support to other departments as required in connection with organisational projects and initiatives.

Assisting with other administrative tasks and providing support to staff across the organisation as required.

Essential Skills and Experience
- Minimum of 2 years' experience in an equivalent finance position.
- Practical experience of bookkeeping and financial administration.
- Practical knowledge and experience of using QuickBooks.
- Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Excel, particularly for maintaining and working with financial spreadsheets.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word and other Microsoft Office applications.
- Highly computer literate and confident in learning and using financial and administrative systems.
- Accurate data entry and record-keeping skills.
- Systematic approach to work, with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Ability to organise and prioritise a busy workload and meet deadlines.
- Ability to work effectively as part of a busy and diverse team.
- Good standard of written and spoken English.
- Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling financial and organisational information.
- Ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, suppliers and other stakeholders.
- Ability to provide administrative support across different departments and assist with organisational project work.

Desirable Skills and Experience
- Experience of working within the community or charity sector, or within a developing organisation.
- Familiarity with project funding and the requirements of charity sector funders.
- Experience of providing administrative support to projects or working across different departments.
- Experience of supporting month-end financial processes and reporting.
- Experience of working with supplier invoices, reconciliations, expenses and payment processes.
- Knowledge or experience of working with charity or project-related financial records.

Flexibility

In order to deliver the stated aims of this post, a degree of flexibility is needed and the post holder may be required to perform work not specifically referred to above. This could include data, administrative and/or project support to other cross-organisational departments. Such duties will fall within the scope of the job within the appropriate pay grade. The job description will therefore be subject to periodic review with the post holder to ensure it accurately reflects the duties that are being performed.

Equal Opportunities

We're an equal opportunity employer, which means we'll consider all suitably qualified applicants regardless of gender identity or expression, ethnic origin, nationality, religion or beliefs, age, sexual orientation, disability status or any other protected characteristic. We recruit and develop our people based on merit and their passion for creating better outcomes, and we're committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Closing Date: Tuesday 20th October 2026

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, if we receive enough suitable applications to take forward to interview prior to the published closing date.

Please note that RMC is not a sponsoring organisation. If your visa requires an extension within the next 12 months with the support of employer sponsorship, the RMC Charity is unable to provide assistance with this.

title: Activity Co-ordinator
description:
Helping others improve and turn their lives around - there's no better feeling. It's what we do for thousands of people at more than 150 sites across the UK. Be a part of it.

Cygnet Healthcare is looking for an Activity Co-ordinator to join our team at Cygnet Raglan House.

The successful candidate will be working 42 hours per week. Working from 09:00 AM to 05:00 PM - Monday to Friday.

Cygnet Raglan House is a 25 bed high support inpatient rehabilitation (level 2) service for women. The service is designed to provide an environment that promotes mental health recovery by focusing on space, personal privacy and dignity. Women admitted to the service often come from multiple placement breakdowns, failed treatment programmes or are stepping down from secure settings.

We are dedicated to understand, stabilise and break the traumatic cycles of relapse that can impact individuals' lives. Our service has been designed with wellness in mind, providing a safe and comfortable environment that promotes efficient rehabilitation and recovery.

Your Day-to-Day at Cygnet Raglan House:

We are seeking an academically strong candidate to support and enhance the care of patients at the service by assisting the Occupational Therapist with;
- Encouraging patients to access and become involved in a variety of activities, as well as maintaining any pre-existing hobbies.
- Planning and implementing therapy programmes whilst ensuring appropriate materials are obtaine
d
- Contributing ideas, facilitating events and activities in a safe manner

We're looking for someone who has
- Experience and/or a passion for working in healthcare
- Some knowledge of Occupational Therapy
- A creative flair and the ability to work as part of an interdisciplinary team
- An awareness of recovery approaches and social inclusion (desirable)

Why Cygnet? We'll offer you
- Salary: £13.15 Per Hour
- Increasing to £13.45 Per Hour after 3 months
- Strong career progression opportunities into management roles
- Monthly reflective practice, & support with CPD opportunities
- Free meal on shift
- Expert clinical supervision & peer support
- Employee referral scheme
- Pension scheme
- Cycle to work scheme & employee discount savings.

Please note that successful candidates will be required to undergo an enhanced DBS check.

This vacancy may close before this date if a large number of applications are received.

What next?

If you care about making a difference - we want to talk to you.

Click the button to apply
